$comment: PR 381 (B6.1) — the dependency vulnerability gate (tools/dep-audit.mjs, CI job `deps`, and every night through nightly.yml). `failAt`: the lowest severity that fails the build, for what ships (prod) and for the build tools (dev). `accepted`: a known advisory that cannot be fixed yet, each with the package, why it is safe for now, the day it was written (`since`) and an end date (`until`, at most 90 days after `since`); after `until` the build fails again until it is fixed or looked at again. Never a silent ignore.

accepted.why: Only the Prisma CLI's config loader uses it (packages/db > @prisma/client > prisma > @prisma/config), to merge our own prisma.config file when migrations run; no visitor's input ever reaches it. The fix (8.x) comes with a Prisma update.

Only the test runner (vitest 3 > tinypool 1.1.1) uses it, on CI and developer machines, with our own test files; it is never in the app image and never sees a visitor's input. The fix needs vitest 4 across every package (a follow-up of PR 381).
